item.title: azure: Announcing: Microsoft Fabric Item Recovery will be enabled by default for tenants without an explicit setting
item.description:
Starting August 23, 2026, Microsoft Fabric Item Recovery will be enabled by default for tenants that do not already have an explicit setting configured. Supported item types will use a 3-day recovery window by default, and admins can review or change the setting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Monitor Logs mirroring into Microsoft Fabric
item.description:
Azure Monitor Logs can now be mirrored from Log Analytics workspaces into Microsoft Fabric in public preview. The telemetry is available in OneLake as Delta Parquet with near real-time availability and no data duplication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: commandline: A wind farm you can talk to: Building a real-time 3D digital twin on Microsoft Fabric
item.description:
The article describes building a real-time 3D digital twin for a wind farm on Microsoft Fabric by combining geometry, telemetry, and language in one simulation. It emphasizes using the model to spend more time on architectural decisions.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
